findings.suggested_fix:
```python
from rebar.llm.failure import _RETRYABLE, ResolutionClass, classify_llm_failure

fallback_on = lambda exc: (
    classify_llm_failure(exc).resolution_class in _RETRYABLE
    or classify_llm_failure(exc).resolution_class is ResolutionClass.CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL
)
```
